name: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (for women only) GNTDNT
benefit:
1. The maximum loan limit will be up to ₹1,25,000/-.
1. The interest rate will be 4% per annum.
1. Under this scheme, 100% loan of the business/occupation amount is provided.
1. The loan amount will consist of 95% National Corporation contribution, 5% State Government contribution and zero beneficiary contribution.

> **Repayment:** The loan amount will have to be repaid in 48 equal monthly instal
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a woman from a Nomadic or Denotified Caste. 1. The annual income limit of the family for income eligibility will be up to ₹3,00,000/- with effect from 1/4/2018. At least 50 percent of the total loan amount will be allocated for families having an annual income of up to ₹1,50,000/-. 1. The applicant's age should be at least 21 years and not more than 50 years as on the date of application. 1. The applicant must have experience in a technical and skilled trade/business. 1. The applicant will have to provide suitable collateral to get the loan.
